In a parallelogram, opposite angles are equal. Therefore, if ∠S = 70°, then ∠R = 70° as well (opposite angle).
Since consecutive angles in a parallelogram are supplementary (add up to 180°), then ∠T = 180° - 70° = 110°.
Again, since opposite angles are equal in a parallelogram, ∠U = 110°.
Therefore, the angle measures are m∠R = 70°, m∠T = 110°, m∠U = 110°. The answer is: $\boxed{1}$
